Contract ManageUserCRUDService::modifyUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		card: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = userid),
		updated: Boolean = if card.oclIsUndefined() 
		then false 
		else (card.BelongedUser.Name = name and
		card.BelongedUser.Address = address) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		result = updated
}
